members.name: label
members.doc: Visible heading and accessible table name. Native title remains a tooltip.

members.name: description
members.doc: What Apply will do, shown under the heading.

members.name: columns
members.doc: The columns, each with a unique, nonblank id and label.

members.name: rows
members.doc: Records contain exactly the declared column IDs, with explicit scalar values.

members.name: selectedIds
members.doc: The selected row ids, when the caller controls the selection.

members.name: defaultSelectedIds
members.doc: The ids selected at first, when DataDiff controls the selection. Without them every enabled proposed change starts selected; unchanged rows are never selectable.

members.name: onSelectionChange
members.doc: Reports the selected row ids, in row order, after each selection change.

members.name: onApply
members.doc: Called only by explicit Apply activation, with selected IDs in row order.

members.name: pending
members.doc: Marks an apply in flight: selection and Apply are unavailable.

members.name: disabled
members.doc: Makes selection and Apply unavailable.

members.name: applyLabel
members.doc: Replaces the whole Apply button label, which otherwise counts the selected changes.

members.name: emptyMessage
members.doc: The text shown when there are no rows.
